faq.q: Can I use Toolaze for free AI breast expansion?
faq.a: New Toolaze users receive 10 free credits after sign-up. Generation cost may vary by the selected image model, resolution, mode, and current Toolaze credit policy shown in the generator.

faq.q: What kind of photo works best?
faq.a: Use a clothed adult photo with a clear upper body, visible shoulders, readable fabric, and simple lighting. Waist-up, half-body, and full-body photos are usually easier than tight crops or covered torsos.
Natural results depend on the source photo, clothing, pose, and prompt. Subtle adjustments usually preserve fabric texture and body balance better than extreme changes.
Use only adult, clothed, consensual photos. Do not request nudity, undressing, explicit content, minors, impersonation, or unauthorized photo edits.

faq.q: Does this tool remove clothing or create nudity?
faq.a: No. Use it only for clothed adult body-proportion previews. Keep clothing intact and use the tool only for consensual, non-explicit image edits.

faq.q: Is this medical or surgical advice?
faq.a: No. The output is only a visual preview for styling and image-editing ideas. It should not be used for medical decisions, sizing guarantees, or surgery planning.
